terms_note: Static PHP site (no robots restrictions found on pages used); 6 pages/PDFs read 4-5 s apart. Copyright notice only. MX v2 (1700 W), XX v2 (1500 W), SXX v2 (1200 W) excluded.

recommended_boxes.note: published as 2.317 cu ft; maker BassBox file, design 'VENTED(1)'; net Vb as printed

drivers.notes: The INFO sheet is titled 'XXX12D2/4 v2' and gives one T/S set; the maker's own box files use the same values as 'XXX 12 D4' with 'Dual voice coils = parallel' (2 ohm). So the set is entered for the D4 model wired in parallel. A D2 version exists (dual 2 ohm, 1 or 4 ohm final) but no separate T/S was found. Sd converted from mm2. Box files print Xmax 2.3 in (58 mm), implausible beside the sheet, not entered. Peak not published. Cut-out not published. Converted from imperial as published: mounting depth 12.75 in, displacement 0.24 cu ft.
